title: 第7章 突破炼脏境驻守矿脉第8章 变故第二次模拟结束
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【三月后，十九种玄级宝药成功炼制出玄级极品‘益骨生根宝丹’，很快叶昌明就将益骨生根宝丹给你送了过来。
在拿到宝丹的时候，你的内心极为感动，此刻对于家族的认同感进行了巨幅的提升。
因为你清楚，即使对于叶家来说，一枚玄级极品宝丹也是不易获取的。
【在你准备好一切之后，服下了这颗玄级宝丹，服下宝丹后，体内不久就排出了少量的污秽，你清楚这是体内的杂质，此次你的根骨提升到了黄级中品。
这就是这颗宝丹的极限了。
但对此你已经很是满意，大多数叶家嫡系弟子也只是黄级根骨，你还有天生药心的天赋，你相信你不会比那些拥有玄级根骨的天才差。
【第四十五年，你的境界突破到了炼脏境初期，来到了炼体三境中的最后一境。
同时这些年你的憾山拳也已达到了融会贯通境巅峰，但由于你的拳意不够，迟迟不能突破到登峰造极。
同样你苦修的蜉蝣踏前斩也卡在了融会贯通的圆满之境无法突破。
【你心中很是着急，但无可奈何，此前你有寻找过父亲叶昌明询问，但他自己也没有领悟过登峰造极境界的武技，所以叶昌明被你问的支支吾吾，没办法教你。
对于这个问题，你寻到了家族秘传，探寻唯一突破到登峰造极境界憾山拳的初代老祖的自传。
其中关于如何突破，初代老祖并未详细写，而是说明，每个人对于同一种武技的理解都是不同的，其他人即使是有大成的拳意或是刀意，也无法教授于人，需要本人亲身领悟。
【看到初代老祖的自传你才清楚，想要突破到融会贯通境武技领悟的‘意’为小成，想要突破到登峰造极需要大成才可，所以自己现在拳意的领悟还不够。
看到这里，你平静了下来，对于武技的突破突然没有那么的着急了，整个人顺其自然。
【同年，因为突破到炼脏境的原因，家族给予你的丹药资源已经不多，对于这个级别的丹药，你内心很是抗拒也不想问父母去要，这样会拖累他们的修行速度。
达到炼脏境后，普通的凡级丹药对于你已经毫无作用，只有黄级的灵药或者灵丹对于你才有帮助。
而你如果想要追上那些玄级根骨的天才的脚步，便需要大量服用灵丹与灵药，否则你突破境界的时间将会拉长。
【家族对于叶家子弟与外人的处理方式是不同的，如外系依附于叶家的客家人，即使是淬体境也需要被叶家强制去处理各种任务或者看守某个岗位，以此来获得叶家的保护与少量的资源支持。
content_en:
[Three months later, nineteen Xuan-level medicinal herbs were successfully refined to produce the Xuan-level top-grade 'Bone-boosting and Root-Promoting Pill'. Soon Ye Changming will send you the Bone-Promoting and Root-Promoting Pill.
When you got the treasure pill, you were extremely moved, and your sense of identity with the family was greatly improved at this moment.
Because you know that even for the Ye family, a top-grade Xuan-level treasure pill is not easy to obtain.
[After you prepare everything, you take this Xuan-level treasure pill. After taking the treasure pill, a small amount of dirt will be discharged from your body soon. You know that this is the impurity in the body. This time, your root bones have been upgraded to the yellow-level intermediate grade.
This is the limit of this treasure pill.
But you are very satisfied with this. Most of the direct disciples of the Ye family only have Huang-level roots. You also have the talent of innate medicine heart. You believe that you will not be worse than those geniuses with Xuan-level roots.
[In the forty-fifth year, your realm broke through to the early stage of Zang Refining Realm, and came to the last of the three realms of Body Refining.
At the same time, your Shanshan Quan has reached the peak of mastery over the years, but due to your lack of boxing intention, you have been unable to break through to the top.
Similarly, your painstaking practice of ephemera stepping forward is stuck in the realm of perfection and cannot be broken through.
[You are very anxious, but there is nothing you can do about it. You have asked your father Ye Changming before, but he himself has never understood the martial arts of reaching the highest level, so Ye Changming hesitated when you asked and couldn't teach you.
Regarding this question, you found the family secrets and the autobiography of the first generation ancestor who was the only person to break through to the ultimate state of Xingshan Quan.
Regarding how to break through, the first-generation ancestor did not write in detail, but explained that everyone has a different understanding of the same martial arts. Even if others have great fist or sword intentions, they cannot be taught to others and need to be understood by themselves.
[After reading the autobiography of the first generation ancestor, you will understand that if you want to break through to the mastery realm of martial arts, you need to achieve a small amount of "intention". If you want to break through to the peak, you need a big achievement, so your current understanding of the boxing intention is not enough.
Seeing this, you calmed down, suddenly no longer so anxious about the breakthrough in martial arts, and just let nature take its course.
[In the same year, due to the breakthrough to the Zang Refining Realm, the elixir resources given to you by your family are not much. For elixirs of this level, you are very resistant in your heart and do not want to ask your parents for them. This will slow down their cultivation speed.
After reaching the Zang-Refining realm, ordinary mortal-level elixirs will have no effect on you, and only yellow-level elixirs or elixirs will be helpful to you.
And if you want to catch up with those geniuses with profound level bones, you need to take a lot of elixirs and elixirs, otherwise it will take longer for you to break through the realm.
[The family treats the children of the Ye family differently from outsiders. For example, the Hakka people who are externally attached to the Ye family, even in the body tempering realm, need to be forced by the Ye family to handle various tasks or guard a certain position, in order to obtain the Ye family's protection and a small amount of resource support.
title_en: Chapter 7 Breaking through the Refining Realm and Guarding the Ore Lode Chapter 8 The Second Simulation of the Incident Ends
